meta.title: Dreamlike - 4
meta.description: The swan curtsies, and the curtain falls.

units.rawText: Perhaps it was by accident, or perhaps it was by design, but you have found your way here.
units.displayText: Perhaps it was by accident, or perhaps it was by design, but you have found your way here.

spans.text: Perhaps it was by accident, or perhaps it was by design, but you have found your way here.

units.rawText: A black goat dances rhythmically in a crevice of the wall.
units.displayText: A black goat dances rhythmically in a crevice of the wall.

spans.text: A black goat dances rhythmically in a crevice of the wall.
(Pick up the black goat.)

units.rawText: The goat seems to be startled. Rarely has it ever been seized like this while transmitting.
units.displayText: The goat seems to be startled. Rarely has it ever been seized like this while transmitting.

spans.text: The goat seems to be startled. Rarely has it ever been seized like this while transmitting.

units.rawText: It coughs up all its information, as though begging for mercy.
units.displayText: It coughs up all its information, as though begging for mercy.

spans.text: It coughs up all its information, as though begging for mercy.

units.rawText: Welcome back.
units.displayText: Welcome back.

spans.text: Welcome back.

units.rawText: Have the Entropics that entered the holding area been cleared out?
units.displayText: Have the Entropics that entered the holding area been cleared out?

spans.text: Have the Entropics that entered the holding area been cleared out?

units.rawText: Yes. Sueyoi and the others are still there.
units.displayText: Yes. Sueyoi and the others are still there.

spans.text: Yes. Sueyoi and the others are still there.

units.rawText: The Boss said that everyone did well for this op, and "<color=orange>N</color>" has expressed her sincere thanks to everyone on her behalf.
units.displayText: The Boss said that everyone did well for this op, and "N" has expressed her sincere thanks to everyone on her behalf.

spans.text: The Boss said that everyone did well for this op, and "
N
" has expressed her sincere thanks to everyone on her behalf.

units.rawText: Everyone in your team is one of the Boss' capable lieutenants, and we hope you will continue to work hard.
units.displayText: Everyone in your team is one of the Boss' capable lieutenants, and we hope you will continue to work hard.

spans.text: Everyone in your team is one of the Boss' capable lieutenants, and we hope you will continue to work hard.

units.rawText: Please thank the Boss for her praise. However, I'll be the only one going back now... Will I be passing the message on to the others?
units.displayText: Please thank the Boss for her praise. However, I'll be the only one going back now... Will I be passing the message on to the others?

spans.text: Please thank the Boss for her praise. However, I'll be the only one going back now... Will I be passing the message on to the others?

units.rawText: Not really, since there is a new mission you'll be leading.
units.displayText: Not really, since there is a new mission you'll be leading.

spans.text: Not really, since there is a new mission you'll be leading.

units.rawText: ...Not Sueyoi, but me?
units.displayText: ...Not Sueyoi, but me?

spans.text: ...Not Sueyoi, but me?

units.rawText: Oh yes. You'll be leading a team to help the Oasis out.
units.displayText: Oh yes. You'll be leading a team to help the Oasis out.

spans.text: Oh yes. You'll be leading a team to help the Oasis out.

units.rawText: What's the matter? You don't look well.
units.displayText: What's the matter? You don't look well.

spans.text: What's the matter? You don't look well.

units.rawText: Is that what the Boss wants?
units.displayText: Is that what the Boss wants?

spans.text: Is that what the Boss wants?

units.rawText: The Boss is helping to calm the frightened agents down, so she doesn't have the time to make further arrangements.
units.displayText: The Boss is helping to calm the frightened agents down, so she doesn't have the time to make further arrangements.

spans.text: The Boss is helping to calm the frightened agents down, so she doesn't have the time to make further arrangements.

units.rawText: Which means this is "N's" decision.
units.displayText: Which means this is "N's" decision.

spans.text: Which means this is "N's" decision.

units.rawText: You would not be wrong to say that. We of "N" are empowered to make decisions when the Boss is busy.
units.displayText: You would not be wrong to say that. We of "N" are empowered to make decisions when the Boss is busy.

spans.text: You would not be wrong to say that. We of "N" are empowered to make decisions when the Boss is busy.

units.rawText: In that case... Why me?
units.displayText: In that case... Why me?

spans.text: In that case... Why me?

units.rawText: Right now, we only have two teams that we can use. Everyone from Prism Squad besides <color=orange>Salmon</color> has gone to assist the other sectors, while Sueyoi and Hatsuchiri are at the holding area.
units.displayText: Right now, we only have two teams that we can use. Everyone from Prism Squad besides Salmon has gone to assist the other sectors, while Sueyoi and Hatsuchiri are at the holding area.

spans.text: Right now, we only have two teams that we can use. Everyone from Prism Squad besides
Salmon
has gone to assist the other sectors, while Sueyoi and Hatsuchiri are at the holding area.

units.rawText: And De Lacey is opposed to "N's" ideals, so you'd better avoid making contact with her.
units.displayText: And De Lacey is opposed to "N's" ideals, so you'd better avoid making contact with her.

spans.text: And De Lacey is opposed to "N's" ideals, so you'd better avoid making contact with her.

units.rawText: This is for the benefit of both of us. You know we were all sorry to see De Lacey leave "N".
units.displayText: This is for the benefit of both of us. You know we were all sorry to see De Lacey leave "N".

spans.text: This is for the benefit of both of us. You know we were all sorry to see De Lacey leave "N".

units.rawText: Do you wish to take this mission?
units.displayText: Do you wish to take this mission?

spans.text: Do you wish to take this mission?

units.rawText: ...Do I have a choice?
units.displayText: ...Do I have a choice?

spans.text: ...Do I have a choice?

units.rawText: Hehe... Trust me, this is also what the Boss wants.
units.displayText: Hehe... Trust me, this is also what the Boss wants.

spans.text: Hehe... Trust me, this is also what the Boss wants.

units.rawText: In that case, I'll arrange for a special escort squad to accompany you.
units.displayText: In that case, I'll arrange for a special escort squad to accompany you.

spans.text: In that case, I'll arrange for a special escort squad to accompany you.

units.rawText: Bon voyage, Lind.
units.displayText: Bon voyage, Lind.

spans.text: Bon voyage, Lind.
